
```{devoirs_choices uncertainty_8_two_choices}
- A fixed relationship that determines one output from specified inputs.:
    correct: false
    feedback: That describes a function relationship; uncertainty concerns incomplete

- A guarantee that a quantity will take one exact, known value.:
    correct: false
    feedback: Uncertainty concerns what is not known precisely; a guaranteed exact
      value leaves no uncertainty.
- The incomplete knowledge about the value a quantity will have.:
    correct: true
    feedback: Correct.
- A bell-shaped curve with a center and spread.:
    correct: false
    feedback: That describes a normal distribution, one possible model of uncertainty
      rather than uncertainty itself.
- The variation in a quantity that remains when its exact value is unknown.:
    correct: true
    feedback: Correct.
```
